Bash(node -e "const { getSharedDb } = require\('./src/database/database.js'\); const db = getSharedDb\(\); const timezoneScheduler = require\('./src/services/email/timezone-scheduler'\); const countries = db.all\('SELECT ct.country_code, ct.timezone, ct.name, ct.offset_hours, ct.business_start, ct.business_end, ct.weekend_days, COUNT\(DISTINCT s.id\) as site_count FROM country_timezones ct LEFT JOIN sites s ON LOWER\(s.country\) = ct.country_code GROUP BY ct.country_code ORDER BY ct.name LIMIT 3'\); const now = new Date\(\); const countriesWithStatus = countries.map\(country => { const offsetMs = country.offset_hours * 60 * 60 * 1000; const localTime = new Date\(now.getTime\(\) + offsetMs\); const countryCode = country.country_code.toLowerCase\(\); const inBusiness = timezoneScheduler.isBusinessHour\(now, countryCode\); return { ...country, current_local_time: localTime.toISOString\(\), in_business_hours: inBusiness, local_hour: localTime.getUTCHours\(\), local_day: localTime.getUTCDay\(\) }; }\); console.log\('API response sample:', JSON.stringify\(countriesWithStatus[0], null, 2\)\);")
